appearance_facts.fact: A blue solid line with circular markers represents Hydroelectricity; the 2010 point is a blue circle near the lower-middle vertical range.
A red dashed line with square markers represents Nuclear energy; the 2010 point is a red square slightly above the 2010 Hydroelectricity point.
A blue text annotation '35%' is positioned just above the 2010 Hydroelectricity marker.
A red text annotation '23%' is positioned just below the 2015 Nuclear energy marker.
A blue text annotation '47%' is positioned above a later Hydroelectricity marker (around 2035).
A red text annotation '28%' is positioned below a later Nuclear energy marker (around 2035).
Both the blue Hydroelectricity line and the red Nuclear energy line converge at the rightmost 2050 data point.
In the early 2000s, the red Nuclear energy line is visibly higher than the blue Hydroelectricity line.
